top_signals.title: India Drives a Global Surge in New Coal Mine Plans
top_signals.summary: India turned into the world’s biggest coal power generation capacity builder, proposing as much as 638 million metric tons annually in new capacity last year. This was a surge from 329 million tons annually in new planned coal capacity a year earlier, and it drove an 11% increase in the global total for the year. The data comes from Global Energy Monitor, as cited by Reuters, and highlights India’s approach to energy security, which is a lot similar to China’s approach, featuring all existing sources of power generation to satisfy…
